questions.knowledge_point: Finding the Real or Imaginary Part of a Scalar Given the Conjugate of a Scaled Vector
questions.worked_solution:
Since $\overset{―}{kv}=\overset{―}{v},$ we get the following equation:

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{―}{kv} & =\overset{―}{k}\,\overset{―}{v} \\ [\begin{aligned}-20+28\text{i} \\ 18-40\text{i}\end{aligned}] & =\overset{―}{k}\,\overset{―}{[\begin{aligned}4 \\ -5-\text{i}\end{aligned}]} \\ [\begin{aligned}-20+28\text{i} \\ 18-40\text{i}\end{aligned}] & =\overset{―}{k}\,[\begin{aligned}\overset{―}{4} \\ \overset{―}{-5-\text{i}}\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}-20+28\text{i} \\ 18-40\text{i}\end{aligned}] & =\overset{―}{k}\,[\begin{aligned}4 \\ -5+\text{i}\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}-20+28\text{i} \\ 18-40\text{i}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}4\overset{―}{k} \\ (-5+\text{i})\overset{―}{k}\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

So, we obtain the system

$$
\{\begin{aligned}4\overset{―}{k}=-20+28\text{i} \\ (-5+\text{i})\overset{―}{k}=18-40\text{i}.\end{aligned}
$$

From the first equation, we get

$$
\overset{―}{k}=-5+7\text{i}
$$

Substituting this into the second equation, we obtain the true statement

$$
(-5+\text{i})(-5+7\text{i})=18-40\text{i}
$$

Therefore, $k=\overset{―}{-5+7\text{i}}=-5-7\text{i}.$

Finally, $\text{Re}(k)=-5.$

questions.worked_solution:
Since $\overset{―}{kv}=\overset{―}{k}\,\overset{―}{v},$ we get the following equation:

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{―}{kv} & =\overset{―}{k}\,\overset{―}{v} \\ [\begin{aligned}20 \\ -4+8\text{i}\end{aligned}] & =\overset{―}{k}\,\overset{―}{[\begin{aligned}-4+8\text{i} \\ 4\end{aligned}]} \\ [\begin{aligned}20 \\ -4+8\text{i}\end{aligned}] & =\overset{―}{k}\,[\begin{aligned}\overset{―}{-4+8\text{i}} \\ \overset{―}{4}\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}20 \\ -4+8\text{i}\end{aligned}] & =\overset{―}{k}\,[\begin{aligned}-4-8\text{i} \\ 4\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}20 \\ -4+8\text{i}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}(-4-8\text{i})\overset{―}{k} \\ 4\overset{―}{k}\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

So, we obtain the system

$$
\{\begin{aligned}(-4-8\text{i})\overset{―}{k}=20 \\ 4\overset{―}{k}=-4+8\text{i}.\end{aligned}
$$

From the second equation, we get 

$$
\overset{―}{k}=-1+2\text{i}.
$$

Substituting this into the first equation, we obtain the true statement

$$
(-4-8\text{i})(-1+2\text{i})=20.
$$

Therefore, $k=\overset{―}{-1+2\text{i}}=-1-2\text{i}.$

Finally, $\text{Re}(k)=-1.$
